summary: FirstService Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing an amendment to its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) to increase the maximum number of common shares repurchasable from 1,600,000 (3.9% of public float) to 4,118,199 (10% of public float), effective June 4, 2026. The NCIB runs from August 26, 2025 to August 25, 2026, with daily purchase limits on TSX and NASDAQ. Shares repurchased will be cancelled. The amendment reflects management’s view that repurchases are an appropriate use of funds and mitigate dilution from stock options. No advisor or premium is specified. Watch for the pace of buybacks and impact on float/reducing share count.
